summary: Iteration 6 partial fail. Backend variants + themeId endpoints WORK (3/3 pytest pass). Frontend has 2 P0 blockers: (a) ProductPage crashes with 'activeImage is not defined' (ReferenceError) — also galleryImages/effectivePrice/effectiveUnit/effectiveOldPrice are referenced but never defined in Product.jsx, so the entire variant picker + gallery + add-to-cart flow is untestable and the page shows the redbox error overlay. (b) 10-theme radio grid is MISSING from admin Settings Branding tab — THEMES is imported into Settings.jsx but never rendered; no data-testid='theme-radio-*' cards exist. Other features PASS: FAB redesign (Headphones icon + gradient inner span), admin variant form UI (prod-add-variant + variant rows work), admin multi-image upload (prod-gallery-upload/files, multiple attr present), Profile.jsx wired to useChat().openChat, ChatContext provides open/close, mobile scroll compact appears smoothly (minor: didn't collapse back at scrollY=20 which is under the 40 hysteresis, but no visible jitter). Backend endpoints for variants (POST/GET/PUT) and themeId persistence all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: activeImage is not defined — also galleryImages, effectivePrice, effectiveUnit, effectiveOldPrice are referenced but never derived. Entire ProductPage crashes on /product/test-variant-honey (and every product page). Uncaught runtime error overlay shown; variant-option-*, gallery-thumb-*, product-add-to-cart cannot render.

THEMES imported (line 4) but the 10 theme radio cards are NOT rendered anywhere in the file. Missing data-testid='theme-radio-emerald/rose/ocean/royal/sunset/teal/gold/midnight/slate/blossom'. Admin cannot pick a preset theme. Save with themeId change never happens from UI.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by ProductPage crash. Could not verify addToCart passes variantLabel or Cart shows variant badge. Backend accepts variants — persistence verified via API.

integration_issues.flow: Multi-image gallery on public product page
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by ProductPage crash. gallery-thumb-* never render because component throws before render.

issues: home-search-icon-compact stays visible when scrolling back to scrollY=20 (below the 40 lower hysteresis threshold). Hide-below-40 logic may not be firing. No visible jitter though.

action_items: Fix Product.jsx: derive `galleryImages = [p.image, ...(p.images||[])].filter(Boolean)` (dedup), `activeImage = galleryImages[galleryIdx] || p.image`, `effectivePrice = selectedVariant?.price ?? p.price`, `effectiveOldPrice = selectedVariant?.oldPrice ?? p.oldPrice`, `effectiveUnit = selectedVariant?.label ?? p.unit`. Also pass variant into addToCart, e.g., addToCart(p, qty, selectedVariant?.label).

Add 10 theme radio grid to admin/Settings.jsx Branding tab: iterate THEMES; render cards with data-testid={`theme-radio-${t.id}`}. Update form state to include themeId, include themeId in the PUT payload of settings-branding-save.

Verify MobileHeader compact hide threshold — appears hide (<40) branch is not toggling; possibly rAF sets state but doesn't clear when scrolling down-then-up quickly, or condition uses > 80 for show without a matching < 40 for hide.
Confirm variant-aware cart badge renders 'বেছে নেওয়া: <label>' on /cart after variants are fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Product.jsx uses several derived values (activeImage, galleryImages, effective*) with no declaration — indicates a lost/never-committed derivation block. Add before `return (...)`.
Settings.jsx: dead import of THEMES; likely the entire theme picker JSX was omitted during the iteration.
Consider stacking `bg-emerald-700` overrides only when a non-default themeId is set to avoid needless !important CSS on default install (current builds inject 2889 chars even for emerald).

success_rate.frontend: ~55% — 2 P0 features (variant picker/gallery on product page, theme radio grid) not usable

seed_data_creation: Created & deleted TEST_Variant Honey Iter6 during pytest run. Existing test-variant-honey seed left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes Product.jsx (add missing derived vars) and Settings.jsx (render THEMES radio grid), re-verify: (1) /product/test-variant-honey shows 3 variant-option-* buttons that update price/unit; (2) gallery-thumb-* swaps main image; (3) add-to-cart carries variant label to /cart with 'বেছে নেওয়া' badge; (4) admin theme-radio-rose click → save → public /` has `background-color: #be123c` in <style id='brand-theme-css'>; then RESET themeId to emerald. Backend already verified.
rca of the issue: Product.jsx render block references activeImage/galleryImages/effectivePrice/effectiveOldPrice/effectiveUnit but they are never declared in the component body (only galleryIdx state + selectedVariant state exist). React throws ReferenceError on first render → entire route unusable. Settings.jsx imports THEMES but does not render the picker JSX; state has no themeId, save button never includes themeId in PUT payload. Both appear to be omissions during main-agent edit.
